customConcept.name: The Cheesecake Factory
customConcept.blurb: A 250-item menu, portions built for two, a bakery case of thirty-odd cheesecakes and a wait for a table every weekend.

state.circumstances: You're the general manager of a Cheesecake Factory in a regional mall in north Dallas. The company owns the restaurant, writes the 250-item menu in Calabasas and bakes the cheesecakes in its own plants; you run a kitchen of forty cooks, a floor of eighty servers and a Saturday wait that can run to an hour, for a salary and a bonus on the restaurant's results.

features.name: Bakery display case
features.pitch: A lit case of thirty-odd cheesecakes at the front door, the last thing guests see on the way out.

features.name: Patio seating
features.pitch: Outdoor tables along the mall's restaurant row.

setting.name: Regional mall, north Dallas
setting.desc: An anchor-sized restaurant on the outside wall of a regional mall off the freeway in north Dallas, with its own entrance and patio. Shoppers at lunch, families and birthday parties at dinner, a wait on every weekend night and a bakery case people stop at on the way out.

ev.text: Holiday shopping season: the mall is packed and the wait runs to ninety minutes.
A new upscale food hall opened at the other end of the mall.

log.text: You're the general manager of a Cheesecake Factory in a regional mall in north Dallas. The company owns the restaurant, writes the 250-item menu in Calabasas and bakes the cheesecakes in its own plants; you run a kitchen of forty cooks, a floor of eighty servers and a Saturday wait that can run to an hour, for a salary and a bonus on the restaurant's results.

mods.label: Cheesecake Factory support center and systems

world.notes: The Cheesecake Factory's fiscal 2024 10-K: average sales per restaurant open the full year about $12.4 million ($237,349 a restaurant week), 215 Cheesecake Factory restaurants, food and beverage costs 22.5% of revenue and labour about 35% (quarterly range 34.2-36.1%). More than 250 menu items are made from scratch to order; the cheesecakes are baked at the company's two bakery plants in Calabasas, California and Rocky Mount, North Carolina, and delivered frozen. Founded as a bakery in Los Angeles in 1972, first restaurant in Beverly Hills in 1978. Menu prices are typical of 2025-26 price trackers and vary by location; a normal adult meal with an entrée and a drink runs $25-35. Menu items and prices are the NorthPark restaurant's own online menu (7700 West Northwest Highway, Dallas) in September 2026; the bar drinks, lemonade, iced tea, soft drinks and draft beer aren't priced online and are estimates. Staff names, rent and local events are invented.

team.name: Renata Alvarez
team.bio: General manager's right hand: the senior manager who runs the floor on Saturday nights, when the wait is an hour and there are 290 seats to turn.

team.name: Derrick Moss
team.bio: Kitchen manager. Forty cooks, a line of stations and a 250-item menu with a spec card for every plate; he knows which stations fall behind first.

team.name: Linh Tran
team.bio: Kitchen manager in training who runs the sauté and pasta stations and trains every new cook on the spec cards.

profile.name: The Cheesecake Factory Incorporated
profile.kind: publicly traded restaurant company based in Calabasas, California
profile.desc: About 215 Cheesecake Factory restaurants averaging $12.4 million a year, plus North Italia and the Fox Restaurant Concepts brands; two bakeries supply the cheesecakes.
profile.personality: Operationally exacting and proud of it: every plate has a spec, every restaurant is measured weekly, and new menus launch twice a year across the whole system at once.

rep.name: Greg Holloway
rep.title: Area director of operations
rep.style: Oversees eight restaurants, visits on a Friday night to watch the line under pressure, and reads the ticket times before he reads the sales.

events.text: The new menu launched system-wide: twenty new items, a week of retraining and a rush of regulars coming to try them.
National Cheesecake Day: half-price slices, and a line out of the bakery case all afternoon.

desk.title: Head office wants more tables turned
desk.text: Greg asks you to cut the average dinner from 72 minutes to 65 on Fridays and Saturdays.
